name: HivePunk 632
subject: OpenDesign (nexu-io/open-design)
thesis: The pages support that OpenDesign is an actively released, large open-source workspace, but they do not support any conclusion about the desktop MCP or window lifecycle code. The requested code-path investigation remains unanswered on the evidence provided.

risks: The pages read do not show whether window-all-closed quits the app or hides the window, so behaviour on closing the last window cannot be assessed.
The pages read do not show a single-instance lock or second-instance handler, so duplicate-instance behaviour cannot be assessed.
The pages read do not show MCP server startup or connect/IPC handling, so a connection-triggered window disappearance cannot be confirmed or ruled out from these pages.
The pages read do not show tray lifecycle code, so minimisation, restore, or quit-from-tray behaviour cannot be assessed.
